Name: AT - Cabinets Cupboards and Closets
Author: skellady
Description:
[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]The furniture you can use: [/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]- Lg. Futan Bear/Junimo Plush/Gourmand Statue 
- All end tables
- All small wall decor that's 16x32 (Anchor, Blue City, Skull Poster, etc.)
- All big wall decor that's 32x32 (Calico Falls, Cloud Decal, Wall Basket, etc.)
[/size][size=3]- Modern Bookcase/Luxury Bookcase/Dark Bookcase[/size]

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4][b]Installation:[/b][/size][/color]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][size=3] [/size]
[size=3]2. Install the latest version of [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
[size=3]3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over Vortex)[/size]
[size=3]4. Unzip the file and place it in your Mods folder[/size]
[size=4]
[/size][size=4]You can check out the rest of my mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/95265773]HERE[/url].[/size]
